game.name: Ziibiing
game.description: New in 0.8.86: the village has moved to its true country - the other continent, 50 N, where the maples run and the manoomin stands. Wigwams on the east bank of a river 34 paces wide, the sugar camp up the trail, the flint, red willow and obsidian banks a short paddle away. Ma'iingan lends one snare and Mitigwaabiike one tomahawk.
